name: fitdist
expr: pd = fitdist(x, 'Normal'); mu = pd.ParameterValues(1); sigma = pd.ParameterValues(2); name_ok = double(strcmp(pd.DistributionName, 'Normal'));
comment: Sig: pd = fitdist(x, 'Name'). numkit returns a struct (.DistributionName, .ParameterValues, .ParameterNames, .NumObservations). MATLAB returns a probability-distribution OBJECT with same .ParameterValues/.DistributionName fields. ParameterValues bit-identical (delegates to mle). MATLAB's class methods (.pdf/.cdf/.icdf) deferred.
